name: qa-graphql
description: GraphQL server testing: per-framework testing (Apollo Server, GraphQL Yoga with Mercurius in its references, Hasura), subscription test authoring, N+1 detection + remediation, and attack-surface hardening (depth/cost limits with introspection + persisted-query catalogs). Distinct from qa-contract-testing/graphql-schema-regression (contract drift detection); this plugin covers server/runtime + framework-specific patterns.
